data.name: Label16.Text
data.value:
NOTE : The above Mount Z Delta is only used to set a mount Delta Z when setting up a mount in the Fixture Table (See Fixture tab, under the Build Tab).
The Fixture Offsets tab uses the Z Delta value from the Fixture Table. This is the value used for the G55 Z offset when a program is run. (See Fixture tab, under the Build Tab).
